competitors.name: Sushanti Filling Station
competitors.keyStrength: Intercepts Dwarka commuter base, high rating

competitiveAdvantage: High volume due to prime arterial location (Pankha Road) and legacy, flagship IOCL outlet with XP100 availability. Integrated multi-energy ecosystem (Petrol, Diesel, CNG) and non-fuel services (Diesel Delivery, Lubricants).
catchmentSplit: Relies on arterial traffic flow on Pankha Road, but faces intense competition for CNG from Jay Garud Gas Station and for premium customers from C M Enterprises. Also loses potential high-value customers to EV-focused Speedways Service Centre and those preferring to avoid congestion.
